mapper.select: SELECT t.* FROM ( SELECT m.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.session_id ORDER BY m.created_at DESC, m.id DESC) AS rn FROM ai_messages m LEFT JOIN ai_generation_tasks g ON g.message_id = m.id LEFT JOIN ai_generation_retries r ON r.source_generation_id = g.id WHERE r.source_generation_id IS NULL AND m.session_id IN #{id} ) t WHERE t.rn = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_messages (session_id, role, content, reasoning_content, sources, created_at) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{reasoningContent}, #{sources}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT m.*, g.id AS generation_id, g.status AS generation_status, g.last_seq, parent.source_generation_id AS retry_of FROM ai_messages m LEFT JOIN ai_generation_tasks g ON g.message_id = m.id LEFT JOIN ai_generation_retries r ON r.source_generation_id = g.id LEFT JOIN ai_generation_retries parent ON parent.generation_id = g.id WHERE m.session_id = #{sessionId} AND r.source_generation_id IS NULL ORDER BY m.created_at ASC, m.id ASC
